meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上 dev-browser 后，Claude 能编写脚本自动操作浏览器：导航网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取数据等，且脚本间共享同一页面状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求浏览网页、填表、截图、提取数据、测试或自动化浏览器操作时触发，例如说出“打开某网址”“点击”“填表”等。

say.text: 打开百度首页，然后截图保存。
say.note: Claude 会创建或连接页面，执行导航和截图。

say.text: 在搜索框输入“自动化”，点击搜索。
say.note: Claude 会定位元素并操作。

say.text: 模拟登录流程：输入账号密码，点击登录按钮。
say.note: Claude 会逐步骤执行，并可能检查登录状态。

howto.what_en: After installing dev-browser, Claude can write scripts to automate browser actions: navigate, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, etc. Page state persists across script executions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to browse, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, test, or automate browser workflows, e.g., saying 'go to [url]', 'click on', 'fill out the form'.

say_en.text: Open baidu.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will create a page and perform navigation and screenshot.

say_en.text: Type 'automation' in the search box and click search.
say_en.note: Claude will locate the element and act.

say_en.text: Simulate login: enter username, password, click login.
say_en.note: Claude will execute steps sequentially and check login state.
